name: analytics
description: Analytics workload over the pqgen 1m datasets. Stand-in for benchmarks/workloads/analytics.json, which is referenced by the task but absent from the workspace (see README, 'Latency optimization').

queries.name: filter + count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx WHERE amount > 500 AND status = 'approved'

queries.name: group by, low cardinality
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), AVG(fee), MIN(ts), MAX(ts) FROM tx GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: group by, 80K groups
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount), COUNT(*) FROM tx GROUP BY customer_id

queries.name: projection + filter, 200K rows
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount * 2 + fee, bucket % 7 FROM tx WHERE bucket < 200 AND NOT is_fraud

queries.name: join 1M x 100K + group by
queries.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*), SUM(t.amount) FROM tx t JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

queries.name: join 1M x 250K + group by
queries.sql: SELECT o.status, SUM(i.quantity), COUNT(*) FROM items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

queries.name: top-N
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount FROM tx ORDER BY amount DESC, tx_id LIMIT 10

queries.name: full sort, 1M rows
queries.sql: SELECT id, uniq_key FROM sk ORDER BY uniq_key

queries.name: filter + group by (sensor)
queries.sql: SELECT sensor_id, AVG(temperature), MAX(humidity), COUNT(*) FROM sensor WHERE status = 'ok' GROUP BY sensor_id

queries.name: 3-way join, comma syntax
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(i.quantity) FROM items i, products p, orders o WHERE o.order_id = i.order_id AND p.product_id = i.product_id AND p.category = 'books'

queries.name: CASE / LIKE / IN + group by
queries.sql: SELECT currency, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM tx WHERE category LIKE 'g%' OR category IN ('travel', 'utilities') GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

queries.name: integer filters + global aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MIN(ts), MAX(ts) FROM tx WHERE bucket BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND merchant_id <> 7 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-03-01 00:00:00'

queries.name: NULL-heavy filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(n50), MAX(n90) FROM nh WHERE n50 IS NOT NULL AND n90 > 100

queries.name: COUNT DISTINCT
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) FROM tx GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: group by + HAVING + ORDER BY aggregate + LIMIT
queries.sql: SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM tx GROUP BY merchant_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY total DESC, merchant_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: date functions + group by
queries.sql: SELECT YEAR(ts), MONTH(ts), COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM tx WHERE status <> 'declined' GROUP BY YEAR(ts), MONTH(ts) ORDER BY 1, 2

queries.name: DATE_TRUNC group by
queries.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS m, status, COUNT(*), SUM(item_count) FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date), status ORDER BY m, status

queries.name: multi-key group by
queries.sql: SELECT currency, category, status, COUNT(*), SUM(fee), AVG(amount) FROM tx GROUP BY currency, category, status ORDER BY currency, category, status

queries.name: LEFT JOIN + COUNT
queries.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.order_id), COUNT(*) FROM cust c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country

queries.name: IN subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM tx WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cust WHERE segment = 'enterprise' AND is_active)

queries.name: CTE + join of aggregates
queries.sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tx GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*), AVG(s.total), MAX(s.n) FROM spend s JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

queries.name: 4-way join + group by + top-N
queries.sql: SELECT p.category, c.segment, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue, COUNT(*) FROM items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category, c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: string functions + group by
queries.sql: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(category, 1, 3)) AS k, LENGTH(currency), COUNT(*) FROM tx GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTR(category, 1, 3)), LENGTH(currency) ORDER BY k

queries.name: derived table + filter on aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(quantity) AS q FROM items GROUP BY order_id) t WHERE q > 20

queries.name: scalar subquery comparison
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM tx) * 3

queries.name: DISTINCT
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT currency, status FROM tx ORDER BY currency, status

queries.name: top-N on string key
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, name, email FROM cust ORDER BY email DESC LIMIT 25

queries.name: EXISTS (correlated)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.quantity >= 10)

queries.name: wide result, 100K rows
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, name, country, city, signup_date, credit_limit, is_active FROM cust WHERE birth_year > 1960

queries.name: sensor time buckets
queries.sql: SELECT sensor_id, HOUR(ts) AS h, MIN(temperature), MAX(temperature), AVG(pressure) FROM sensor WHERE humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 70 GROUP BY sensor_id, HOUR(ts) ORDER BY sensor_id, h LIMIT 100
